deferred_demand.preservation: Keep first observable timestamp through same-direction command updates and invalid samples. Retain resolved/progress pairs and already valid suspicion/watch evidence. deferred_demand.cancellation_without_valid_evidence: If current signed net command returns below frozen material threshold during outage and there is no prior valid unresolved suspicion/non-response evidence, close deferred-only obligation with CANCELED_BEFORE_RECOVERY_NO_VALID_FAULT_EVIDENCE. deferred_demand.reversal: During invalidity, update directional deferred context from current signed net demand. If still material in opposite direction, keep oldest relevant unresolved demand age and any prior valid suspicion; do not credit motion or reset pairs. If no prior valid evidence and demand crosses below material, close old deferred-only obligation, then a later opposite material demand establishes a new deferred obligation at its own first crossing.

recovery.trigger: First INVALID-to-VALID released measurement reevaluates active deferred observable demand regardless of command_event; also reevaluate if valid prior epoch/watch exists.
recovery.epoch_creation: For deferred-only material current net demand, open one paired-reference epoch at recovery from preserved resolved pair. recovery.measurement_credit: Evaluate first recovered measurement against preserved matched progress/resolved pair before any checkpoint reset. Qualified directional motion uses frozen minimum/ratio profile; only then may checkpoint pair advance atomically.
recovery.no_fresh_grace: Recovery does not change first observable timestamp, prior watch start, suspicion age/count, or grant a new response window. Invalid rows never increment fault evidence.
recovery.confirmed_latch: A confirmed tracking fault remains latched through invalid measurement; Contract 15A external recovery authority unchanged.
